records.accepted_English: This managed reporting and hosted AI route is available only while its current zero-cost configuration remains verified. It must not purchase credits, upgrade a plan or use a paid fallback. Free limits can make requests unavailable; free access is not unlimited or guaranteed indefinitely.
records.required_display_predicate: Actual current plan/model/resource checks and declared verification validity; stale/failed/incompatible verification leaves managed routes disabled. This is not current deployment or perpetual billing certification.
semantic_obligations: Availability only while current zero-cost configuration remains verified
No credits, upgrade or paid fallback
Free capacity neither unlimited nor guaranteed indefinitely

records.accepted_English: The verified managed route can file a limited technical summary on the public spaCR GitHub repository without your own GitHub account. Public issues can be indexed and copied and cannot be reliably unpublished. The route must remain zero-cost to the maintainer; when free capacity is unavailable, the request is refused or, only if the disclosed storage and retry policy permits it, queued.
records.required_display_predicate: Strict typed summary actually excludes raw logs/settings/paths/personal text; owner zero-cost gate and independent report quotas implemented. Queue only if explicitly permitted by bounded storage/retry policy. Actual permitted bounded queue with disclosed stored content/location/retention/deletion/retry limits, valid purpose-specific consent and atomic request identity/reconciliation required; otherwise refuse. General notice is not acknowledgment of an actual queued request.
semantic_obligations: Limited summary to public spaCR GitHub without user account
Public issues can be indexed and copied and cannot reliably be unpublished.
Zero cost mandatory; refusal unless disclosed storage/retry policy permits queue

records.accepted_English: The verified hosted route sends a limited technical summary to the cloud AI service without requiring your own AI account. Its answer is generated advice, not a verified diagnosis, and no command is run automatically. The route must remain zero-cost to the maintainer. When free capacity is unavailable, the request is refused or, only if the disclosed storage and retry policy permits it, queued. Public issue filing is a separate action with its own limits.
records.required_display_predicate: Hosted selection/actual new request; typed input/privacy disclosure and opt-out; verified free model allowlist, atomic quota enforcement and no paid fallback. Reused advice does not imply a new transfer. Actual permitted bounded queue with disclosed stored content/location/retention/deletion/retry limits, valid purpose-specific consent and atomic request identity/reconciliation required; otherwise refuse. General notice is not acknowledgment of an actual queued request.
semantic_obligations: Limited technical summary sent to cloud AI without user account
Generated advice, not verified diagnosis; no automatic command execution
Public filing separate; zero cost and conditional queue/refusal

records.accepted_English: Hosted chat sends the question and the conversation context you explicitly include to the cloud service. That text may contain personal or confidential information; review it before sending. Prior CLI conversations, raw logs and settings are not transferred automatically. The hosted route must remain zero-cost to the maintainer and refuses requests when free capacity is exhausted or queues them only if the disclosed storage and retry policy permits it.
records.required_display_predicate: Hosted mode selected, explicit context preview/consent and transfer boundary implemented, zero-cost verified, no arbitrary-text anonymity claim or automatic raw CLI history import. Actual permitted bounded queue with disclosed stored content/location/retention/deletion/retry limits, valid purpose-specific consent and atomic request identity/reconciliation required; otherwise refuse. General notice is not acknowledgment of an actual queued request.
semantic_obligations: Hosted chat sends the question and the conversation context the user explicitly includes; that text may contain personal or confidential information. This content-selection obligation does not promise anonymous or metadata-free transport.
Review before sending; no automatic prior CLI conversation/log/settings transfer
Zero-cost requirement and refusal or explicitly permitted queue

records.accepted_English: The hosted AI service has reached its free limit. This request was refused and no new answer is available. The managed route must not buy credits, upgrade a plan or select paid inference. You can try again when free capacity is available. Public reporting remains separate and may still be available within its own limits.
records.required_display_predicate: Confirmed quota refusal without successful inference; no successful queued request promised; independent report route status actually checked. Do not assert all transport was cancelled.
semantic_obligations: Actual refusal and no new answer, not cancellation or queue
No credits, upgrade or paid inference
Later free capacity conditional; independent public route may remain available within own limits

records.accepted_English: Free AI capacity is currently unavailable. Your request is queued under the stated storage and retry policy; it has not completed. No paid fallback or plan upgrade will be used. You can remove the queued request before another attempt starts; removing it cannot undo data already sent in an earlier attempt.
records.required_display_predicate: Actual permitted bounded queue exists with disclosed content/location/retention/deletion and retry limits; consent valid; server/client request identity reconciled. Never imply raw inputs or CLI history automatically saved.
semantic_obligations: Actually queued under stated policy; not completed
No paid fallback or plan upgrade
Remove before next attempt; cannot undo earlier sent data

records.accepted_English: The managed reporting service has reached its free limit and did not accept this report for filing. No paid fallback or plan upgrade will be used. You can retry later. Hosted AI has separate limits and does not establish that a public issue was filed.
